name: The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan
short_description: A five-star Ritz-Carlton in Jakarta's Mega Kuningan business district, known for spacious rooms, a two-level Club Lounge, and unusual Spa Terrace suites with private plunge pools.
ai_summary: The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan is a long-established five-star hotel set in the Mega Kuningan diplomatic and business district of South Jakarta. It should not be confused with the sister Ritz-Carlton Jakarta at Pacific Place in the SCBD/Sudirman area; this property is the older, resort-styled tower whose fifth-floor pool, spa and gym create a calm buffer from the city traffic. Reviewers consistently single out the service as its strongest asset, describing staff who greet returning guests by name and remember drink orders, plus a two-level Club Lounge that several call the best executive lounge in Jakarta, with generous all-day food presentations. Rooms are among the largest in the city and open onto floor-to-ceiling skyline views. Its signature draw is a small set of Spa Terrace suites, each with a private sunken jacuzzi or plunge pool and rock garden; bloggers love the concept but note these particular rooms feel compact and the heated water cannot be cooled. Common watch-outs are a somewhat dated feel in places and the long, traffic-dependent drive to Soekarno-Hatta airport. Dining spans the Asia and Lobo restaurants plus the Ozone bar. Overall it reads as a service-led luxury stay favored by both business travelers and staycationers.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the Ritz-Carlton Jakarta at Pacific Place?
faqs.answer: No. This is the Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan, an older resort-styled tower in the Mega Kuningan business district. The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place is a separate hotel in the SCBD/Sudirman area.

faqs.question: What makes the Spa Terrace suites special?
faqs.answer: These limited suites each include a private sunken jacuzzi or plunge pool with a terrace and rock garden. Only a handful are available per night, so they book out early; bloggers note the rooms themselves are compact.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from the airport?
faqs.answer: Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) is roughly 25 km away, typically 45 minutes to well over an hour by road depending on Jakarta traffic.

reviews.title: REVIEW: Ritz Carlton Mega Kuningan (Jakarta)
reviews.author: Jarvis Marcos
reviews.summary: Spa Terrace suite with a private sunken jacuzzi, terrace and rock garden. Rated 8/10: compact room but exceptional housekeeping, a Club Lounge with all-day food, and staff who remembered orders and greeted guests by name.

reviews.title: Ritz Carlton Mega Kuningan Jakarta (Spa Terrace Suite staycation)
reviews.author: drracheldjuanda
reviews.summary: Family stay in the Spa Terrace Suite with in-room heated jacuzzi and floating breakfast. Praises the two-level club lounge and kid-friendly touches, but the room is very small, the hotel feels older, and the jacuzzi cannot be cooled.
